assessment: The manuscript investigates how the tandem reader domains in BPTF co-recognize two types of modifications present on histone tails, H3K4me3 and H3 acetylation. The authors provide compelling evidence for regulation of such recognition by the conformational restriction of histone tails due to interactions with nucleosomal DNA. The findings contribute valuable new insights into how the nucleosomal context impacts the action of tandem reader domains and should be of much interest to the broader chromatin field.
